channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US Senate approves Iran war powers resolution: What that means for Trump
item.description: Four Republicans cross party lines to vote in favour of the measure.

item.title: North Korea commissions warship as Kim eyes nuclear navy
item.description: Kim Jong Un vows to equip North Korea's navy with nuclear weapons, signaling a strategic shift in military capabilities.

item.title: Ukraine strikes strategic Russian bridge in Crimea
item.description: Ukraine strikes strategic Russian bridge in Crimea

item.title: Iran war day 117: Nuclear inspections dispute as US Senate curbs war powers
item.description: Iran and the US clash over nuclear inspections and Hormuz as negotiators push for a final deal within 60 days.

item.title: Congress passes war powers measure for first time, breaking with Trump over Iran
item.description: The resolution passed on Tuesday was largely symbolic, but it adds to pressure on the White House to end the conflict once and for all.

item.title: UN says it will evacuate sailors stranded in Strait of Hormuz, as Rubio warns against tolls
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned Iran that no country can charge fees for ships to travel through the strait.

item.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
item.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

item.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero pleads not guilty to alleged assault on his father
item.description: Ahmed al Ahmed tackled one of the gunmen who killed 15 people at a Jewish event in December.

item.title: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
item.description: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.

item.title: Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting, authorities say
item.description: Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.
